audit_item_1_race_time_aggregation_and_w.description: Resolution of implied ~2,007s DNF mean vs earlier prose claiming laps 1-15 (90-1200s).
audit_item_1_race_time_aggregation_and_w.root_cause_analysis: The simulation engine checks mechanical failure hazard across ALL 58 laps of the race (reliability_model.base_mech_hazard per lap), plus opening lap collisions (lap 1 collision hazard). Retirements do NOT stop at lap 15; they occur across laps 1 through 58. The previous report note stating DNFs only occur on laps 1-15 with times 90-1200s was factually erroneous prose. In reality, the DNF distribution spans lap 1 (0.0s elapsed) to lap 58 (5,571.66s elapsed), with a true mean retirement lap of 22.87 and true mean DNF time of 2,007.19s for Reference_1Stop and 2,007.65s for SafetyCar_Reactive. Direct evaluation of the 10,000 raw simulation records proves the weighted-mean arithmetic identity holds to machine epsilon.

all_run_paired_time_difference.formula: t_reactive - t_reference across all 10,000 paired draws
all_run_paired_time_difference.notes: Unconditional metric reflecting all simulated runs including early retirements.

completed_run_marginal_means.notes: Conditional on full 58-lap race completion. Real-world benchmark: official winner 5,193.291s (-0.058% and -0.088% error).

matched_finished_run_paired_difference.formula: t_reactive - t_reference strictly for paired runs where BOTH policies finish

retirement_coupling_under_crn.explanation: Under Common Random Numbers, mechanical and collision hazard streams are evaluated on identical random draws across paired vehicle instances.

audit_item_2_sc_vsc_transition_classific.description: Transition-based accounting of 1,284 raw race-control messages and exact initiation hazard definitions.

reconciliation_identities.vsc_activations: 128 standalone return green + 52 escalation to SC == 180 total activations
reconciliation_identities.green_originating_episodes: 258 (green to SC) + 180 (green to VSC) == 310 (total SC phases) + 128 (standalone VSC) == 438 total green-originating episodes
reconciliation_identities.raw_records_traceability: 311 (SC decl) + 180 (VSC decl) + 310 (SC return) + 128 (VSC return) + 355 (status/sector notices) == 1284 raw records

exposure_denominators.selection_justification: In discrete-lap simulation, new incidents are evaluated exclusively when current_state == NONE (green flag). Thus, eligible green-lap exposure (L_green) is the mechanistically valid denominator for incident initiation.

sc_direct_green_initiation_hazard.notes: Direct transition from green flag to physical Safety Car.

sc_total_phases_hazard.notes: All in-race SC phases (incorporating the 52 VSC escalations at macroscopic phase level).

vsc_total_activations_hazard.notes: All VSC deployments from green running in 2015-2024 era.

vsc_standalone_phases_hazard.notes: VSC phases concluding strictly to green without escalating to full SC.

vsc_to_sc_escalation_probability.notes: Conditional transition probability P(escalate to SC | active VSC).

hazard_rate_audit.pre_2015_chronological_cutoff: VSC hazard strictly enforced as 0.000 for seasons prior to 2015.
hazard_rate_audit.processional_starts_exclusion: Spa 2021 pre-race formation start behind SC is excluded from in-race green incident generation.
hazard_rate_audit.simulation_loop_guard: In check_new_incident(), if current_state != NONE, 0 laps and None are returned. A VSC cannot be counted as a new green-originating deployment in the simulation loop.

variance_reduction_definitions.race_time_variance_reduction: 99.997% reduction in Var(t_A - t_B) under CRN vs independent sampling across 5 seeds.
variance_reduction_definitions.position_variance_reduction: 92.33% reduction in Var(pos_A - pos_B) under CRN vs independent sampling across 5 seeds.

audit_item_3_crn_marginal_equivalence_st.kolmogorov_smirnov_interpretation_standa: Two-sample Kolmogorov-Smirnov tests across 5 seeds yielded D <= 0.052 and p >= 0.4981, satisfying practical equivalence tolerance Delta_equiv <= 0.060. Per rigorous statistical guidelines, failure to reject H_0 is strictly reported as no statistically detectable marginal distribution difference in the tested samples, and is never asserted as mathematical proof of identity.

table_a_raw_message_ledger.source_system: FIA Official Race Control Messaging System via OpenF1 /v1/race_control and FIA Steward Bulletins

SAFETY_CAR_DEPLOYED.description: Official broadcast announcements declaring deployment of the physical Safety Car.
SAFETY_CAR_DEPLOYED.breakdown: 258 direct in-race green initiations + 52 VSC-to-SC escalations + 1 pre-race start at Spa 2021

VSC_DEPLOYED.description: Official broadcast announcements declaring activation of the Virtual Safety Car procedure.

SAFETY_CAR_ENDING.description: Official broadcast notices announcing physical Safety Car withdrawal at the end of the current lap.
SAFETY_CAR_ENDING.breakdown: 310 physical SC phases concluding back to green flag or race finish

VSC_ENDING.description: Official broadcast notices announcing termination of standalone Virtual Safety Car procedure.
VSC_ENDING.breakdown: 128 standalone VSC phases concluding directly back to green flag

STATUS_SECTOR_AND_TRACK_CLEAR_NOTICES.description: Repeated deployment notices within 120s, sector yellow flag warnings, and administrative track confirmations.

table_b_derived_event_lifecycle_ledger.lifecycle_accounting_note: This ledger models physical on-track incident episodes and their state transitions. It is NOT a partition of raw messages. The 180 Green->VSC initiations subsequently partition into 52 escalations to SC and 128 standalone conclusions, without inflating the total incident count.

green_to_sc_direct_in_race.definition: Incident on green track immediately requiring physical Safety Car.

green_to_vsc_activations.definition: Incident on green track initiated under Virtual Safety Car procedure.

vsc_to_sc_escalations.definition: Active VSC episode escalated to physical Safety Car due to recovery complications / barrier repairs.

vsc_to_green_standalone_conclusions.definition: Active VSC episode successfully concluded without physical Safety Car intervention.

sc_to_green_conclusions.definition: Physical Safety Car phases concluding to green flag (258 direct + 52 via VSC escalation).

pre_race_or_processional_sc_intervention.definition: Spa 2021 pre-race formation start behind SC under torrential rain (excluded from green incident generation).

lifecycle_identities.sc_phase_conservation: 310 in-race SC phases == 258 direct green initiations + 52 VSC escalations (310 == 310)
lifecycle_identities.green_episodes_conservation: 258 direct SC + 180 green VSC == 438 total green-originating episodes (438 == 438)
lifecycle_identities.severity_resolution_conservation: 310 total SC phases + 128 standalone VSC phases == 438 total green-originating episodes (438 == 438)

direct_green_to_sc_initiation_hazard.definition: True green-state initiation hazard for physical SC. Strictly excludes 52 escalations occurring while VSC is already active and 1 pre-race start.

green_to_vsc_initiation_hazard.definition: True green-state initiation hazard for VSC across the 2015-2024 era (all 180 VSC events originate from green flag).

conditional_vsc_to_sc_escalation_probabi.definition: Conditional transition probability of escalation from active VSC to physical SC: P(escalate to SC | active VSC).

conditional_standalone_vsc_outcome_proba.definition: Conditional probability that an active VSC concludes without SC escalation: P(standalone conclusion | active VSC).

descriptive_aggregate_sc_phase_to_green_.definition: Descriptive macro ratio of all 310 SC phases to green laps. MUST NOT be described or used as conditional green-state initiation hazard.

descriptive_standalone_vsc_outcome_rate.definition: Descriptive standalone VSC outcome rate per green lap. MUST NOT be described or used as the VSC initiation hazard.

simulator_implementation_audit.audit_question_1_sc_initiation_green: Evaluated strictly when current_state == NONE; incident_roll < p_sc deploys FULL_SC.
simulator_implementation_audit.audit_question_2_vsc_initiation_green: Evaluated strictly when current_state == NONE; p_sc <= incident_roll < p_sc + p_vsc deploys VSC.
simulator_implementation_audit.audit_question_3_vsc_to_sc_escalation: Implemented in engine.py: while in VSC, scenario.get_vsc_escalation_draw() evaluates conditional escalation prob (52/180 = 0.28889).
simulator_implementation_audit.audit_question_4_green_guard_behavior: When current_state != NONE, green-originating incident generation is blocked, preventing a second green incident. Legitimate VSC->SC escalation is evaluated inside the active neutralisation block once per VSC episode.
simulator_implementation_audit.audit_question_5_configured_0_0150_calib: 0.0150 was derived from 310 / 20,722 ~ 0.01496 (macro total SC phases across total laps). It represents total SC phases, not direct green SC initiations (258/19,420 = 0.01328).
simulator_implementation_audit.audit_question_6_exposure_consistency: Model distinguishes direct green initiation (0.01328), VSC green initiation (0.01328), and conditional escalation (0.28889). 310/19,420 is labeled strictly as descriptive aggregate phase ratio.
